novice scout.text: The novice scout. Learn from basic moveset. Can disengage at will.

scout.text: The scout. Learn from the scout moveset when you level up. Get 1 more max health. Can disengage at will.
scout.flavor: You use your new knowledge to improve yourself as a scout. You are now something like a real scout!

rogue.text: The rogue. Learn from the scout moveset and get 1 more max health. Rogues can dodge attacks for a turn. Also gain the <Sneak> skill, which gives you 2 extra turn points at the beginning of combat.
rogue.flavor: You realized that no matter how strong you get, there are always stronger foes. Instead, you learn to use your quick wits to take the upper hand in combat. You are now a rogue!

ranger.text: The ranger. Learn from the ranger moveset and get 1 more max health. Rangers can disengage at will. Also gain the <Sneak> skill, which gives you 2 extra turn points at the beginning of combat.
ranger.flavor: You realized that no matter how strong you get, there are always stronger foes. Instead, you learn to use your quick wits to take the upper hand in combat. You are now a rogue!

fighter.text: The fighter class. Get 2 more max health and learn from the fighter moveset when you level up. Can charge in for melee damage when disengaged.
fighter.flavor: You focus your mind on the intricate movements and strategies of combat. You are now a fighter!

brawler.text: The brawler class. Get 2 more max health and learn from the brawler moveset when you level up. Can grab at will.
brawler.flavor: You focus your mind on the intricate movements and strategies of combat. You are now a fighter!

warrior.text: The warrior class. Get 1 more max health and learn from the warrior moveset when you level up. Can grab at will.
warrior.flavor: You focus your mind on the intricate movements and strategies of combat. You are now a fighter!

forester.text: The forester. Learn from the nature moveset when you level up. Can recover yourself from injury. Also gain the <Herbal Remedy> skill, which allows you to heal back 1 damage after each fight.
forester.flavor: Your new knowledge allows you to improve your perception of the surroundings. You are now a forester!

apprentice.text: The apprentice. Learn from the spellcasting moveset when you level up. Can gather yourself at will.
apprentice.flavor: You have learned the secrets of spellcasting. You are able to practice the gathering and focusing of mana to manipulate the physical world.
